summary: Use an Empty State when a list or screen has nothing to show, to say why and offer one next step.

useWhen.text: Say what's missing, then what to do next.

anatomy.holds: description: 12 px; why it's empty or what to do. Hidden when showDescription is false.

examples.purpose: An empty payments card, the guide's In context: the Recent payments card shows the Empty State until there's a payment; Make a payment (onPress) adds one, and the screen swaps the Empty State for the list. The icon is the guide's own Nothing yet capsule (ic_wallet with Emphasis Medium, the soft icon for an empty list).
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Recent payments</Card.Title>
  <EmptyState
    iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_wallet" modes={{ Emphasis: 'Medium' }} />}
    title="No payments yet"
    description="Payments you make will show up here."
    buttonLabel="Make a payment"
    onPress={() => {}}
  />
</Card>

from.quote: The Recent payments card shows the empty state until there’s a payment. Make a payment adds one, and the screen swaps the empty state for the list.

examples.purpose: Couldn't load: a red error icon when loading failed (Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, set on the Icon Capsule so the button keeps its own look), and the button retries.
examples.jsx:
<EmptyState
  iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_error" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }} />}
  title="Couldn’t load payments"
  description="Check your connection and try again."
  buttonLabel="Try again"
  onPress={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: A red error icon when loading failed; the button retries.

examples.purpose: Retrying: while a retry is already running, the button is disabled. Empty State's own button takes no disabled, so a disabled Button goes in buttonSlot, as in the guide's Retrying example; it gets Empty State's modes.
examples.jsx:
<EmptyState
  iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_error" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }} />}
  title="Couldn’t load payments"
  description="Check your connection and try again."
  buttonSlot={<Button label="Try again" disabled />}
/>

from.quote: Disable the button while a retry is already running.

props.name: title
props.description: On the web, a titled Empty State is a section with role region named by its title (accessibilityRole summary), and the title is a heading (h1). Declared: Title text for the empty state Empty when omitted. Storybook's default story supplies the payments copy. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: description
props.description: Body description text. Empty when omitted. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: showDescription
props.description: Whether to show the description text. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: iconSlot
props.description: Left out, the default icon is hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden on the web); an IconCapsule you pass stays an unnamed image (role img). Declared: Custom slot for the icon area. Omit for the default IconCapsule. Pass `null` to remove the icon. Custom nodes receive `modes`.

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: Custom slot for the action. Pass `null` to remove it. Omit to use `buttonLabel` / `onPress` when one of those is set; otherwise no button.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: With buttonLabel or onPress, and no buttonSlot, Empty State draws a Button that gets its modes; with neither, there is no button. Declared: Label for the default action. Renders a button only together with a label or `onPress`.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler for the default action.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the Empty State in place of its title. Without a title and without accessibilityLabel, the Empty State has no role or name.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection EmptyState reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: On the Icon Capsule in iconSlot, Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative gives Figma's red error capsule (#f50030). Set on Empty State instead, it would also reach the button. Declared: A token collection EmptyState reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
